title: Signed interchange at one strict finite quotient
statement: For arbitrary cochain complexes P,Q and a map s with the homogeneous Koszul formula, scalar extension of s at each positive quotient, followed by the normalized balanced-tensor comparison [lem-pur-integral-ambient-operation-models], equals that comparison followed by the coherent signed tensor swap [def-pur-finite-pullback-tensor-braiding] transported to the strict tower [def-pur-completed-pullback-tower-realizations]. This compares finite quotient complexes only; it has no completion augmentation, Roos mapping fibre, or derived localization. The ordinary generator and tensor notions are [def-sf-integral-hom-reduction-models].

proof.text: Evaluate both routes on the quotient generator with scalar a of a homogeneous tensor in bidegree (i,j). The balanced-tensor normalization and the coherent signed formula give the same (-1)^(ij) sign; balancing moves a between the two factors without any further sign.

theorem tensor_tower_signed_coordinate
    (P Q : CochainComplex (integralTowerModules l E X) ℤ)
    (s : (constructibleTensorTotal l E X).obj (P, Q) ⟶
      (constructibleTensorTotal l E X).obj (Q, P))
    (hs : ∀ (i j : ℤ) (U : X.ProEtᵒᵖ)
      (x : (P.X i).val.obj U) (y : (Q.X j).val.obj U),
      (s.f (i + j)).val.app U (IntegralHom.totalPair.{u, u}
        X (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E X) P Q i j U x y) =
        (i * j).negOnePow •
          (eqToHom (congrArg
            (fun k : ℤ ↦ ((constructibleTensorTotal l E X).obj (Q, P)).X k)
              (add_comm j i))).val.app U
            (IntegralHom.totalPair.{u, u} X
              (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E X) Q P j i U y x))
    (n : ℕ) :
    ((IntegralOnSlice.tower l E X none).map s).app (op n) ≫
        ((IntegralAmbient.tensorTowerIso l E X).hom.app (Q, P)).app (op n) =
      ((IntegralAmbient.tensorTowerIso l E X).hom.app (P, Q)).app (op n) ≫
        (strictTensorSignedSwap l E X P Q).app (op n)
